b.clean: The carpal steam operates on a simple principle: every participating family contributes one morning or one afternoon per week, and in return receives the same number of journeys for their own children. Drivers must hold a full license and appropriate insurance, and must agree to carry a first aid kit at all times. In the event of a change to the timetable, coordinator will notify all members by text message no later than 6 o'clock the previous evening.
